toll_bridge.name: Toll Bridge
toll_bridge.door: A bandit leans on the rail of a narrow bridge.
toll_bridge.text: "Toll's 20 gold, friend. Or you can swim." He grins and taps his club.

success.text: He counts the coins twice and waves you over.
He laughs and lets you pass. He even warns you: his friends wait ahead, half asleep.

fail.text: "Nice try." He takes a few coins for his trouble.

success.text: He runs, dropping his purse on the planks.

fail.text: He whistles. Bigger friends step out of the reeds!

success.text: You climb along the beams and slip past everyone ahead. No fight this time!

fail.text: A beam snaps and you fall into the cold river.

hooded_stranger.name: Stranger on the Road
hooded_stranger.door: A hooded figure sits by a small fire and wants a word.
hooded_stranger.text: "Rough road ahead," says the stranger, a scarred sellsword. "I could use the work. Or the company."

success.text: "Coin first, then we fight." Bram the Sellsword joins you for the next battle.
"Ha! I like you. This one's free." Bram joins you for the next battle.

fail.text: "Free? Get lost." He pulls his hood down and ignores you.

success.text: He shares his stew and a tip about the road ahead.

fail.text: The stew was not fresh. You start the next fight sick.

old_shrine.name: Mossy Shrine
old_shrine.door: An old stone shrine glows faintly between the trees.
old_shrine.text: Candles still burn at the shrine, though no one has been here for years. A bowl holds old coins.

success.text: Warm light washes over you. Your wounds close.
The carvings tell of old battles. You learn from them.

fail.text: The words are too old to read.

success.text: You grab the coins before the candles flicker out.

fail.text: The candles flare! Angry spirits burn your hands and wake the woods.

trapped_chest.name: Abandoned Cart
trapped_chest.door: A broken cart lies on its side. A chest is still tied to it.
trapped_chest.text: The chest has a rusty lock. You spot a thin wire running from the lid to a hidden needle.

success.text: Click. Inside: a potion and some scrap.

fail.text: The needle pricks you. Poison! You start the next fight poisoned.

success.text: The lid splits. Gold spills out.

fail.text: CRASH. Every monster nearby heard that.

success.text: Under the seat: a map of the road. You will strike first in the next fight.

fail.text: Just old straw and a cranky mouse.
